name: Lieserl Albert Einstein
original_name: 丽瑟尔 · 阿尔伯特 · 爱因斯坦
source: The greatest scientist in human history and an incarnation of genius. She proposed the theory of relativity at the age of 16 and learned calculus and linear algebra at the age of 8. She and Tesla are best friends.
